# Parchment

> Parchment is a secure, end-to-end credential network platform enabling K-12 schools and higher education institutions to digitize, manage, and issue student records, transcripts, diplomas, and digital badges with FERPA compliance.

Parchment serves both K-12 and higher education sectors with comprehensive solutions for records management, credential issuing, and student data security. The platform streamlines workflows for transcript services, diploma fulfillment, admissions processing, and modern digital credential formats like badges and Comprehensive Learner Records (CLR).

## Key Topics

- FERPA Compliance
- Digital Credentials
- Transcript Management
- Records Digitization
- K-12 Records Management
- Higher Education
- Credential Issuing
- Student Records
- Digital Badges
- Diploma Services
- Document Management
- Admissions & Enrollment
- Data Security
- SIS Integration
- Comprehensive Learner Records (CLR)

## Platform Overview

- [Parchment Homepage](https://www.parchment.com): Credential network for K-12 and higher education with secure end-to-end credentials support

## Higher Education Solutions

- [Credential Issuing Platform](https://www.parchment.com/platform/higher-education/issuing): Higher ed credential issuing platform with digital badges support
- [Transcript Services](https://www.parchment.com/platform/higher-education/transcript-services): Higher ed transcript services with digital-first ordering and fulfillment
- [Diploma Services](https://www.parchment.com/platform/higher-education/diploma-services): Higher ed diploma services for digital and print credential issuance
- [Digital Badges](https://www.parchment.com/platform/higher-education/digital-badges): Digital Badges platform for verifiable stackable credentials
- [Certificate Services](https://www.parchment.com/platform/higher-education/certificate-services): Certificate Services for digital and printed credential issuance
- [Comprehensive Learner Records (CLR)](https://www.parchment.com/platform/higher-education/clr-services): Comprehensive Learner Records platform for alternative transcripts
- [Admissions & Enrollment Platform](https://www.parchment.com/platform/higher-education/admissions-enrollment): Admissions and enrollment platform for student recruitment workflow
- [Recruit](https://www.parchment.com/platform/higher-education/admissions-enrollment/recruit): Recruit platform for higher ed student recruitment and lead generation
- [Receive](https://www.parchment.com/platform/higher-education/receive): Receive platform for transcript management and admissions processing
- [Records Digitization](https://www.parchment.com/platform/higher-education/records-digitization): Higher ed records digitization with scanning and secure storage

## K-12 Solutions

- [K-12 Records Management System](https://www.parchment.com/platform/k-12): K-12 Records Management System with digitization and transcript services
- [Award K-12](https://www.parchment.com/platform/k-12/award-k-12): Award K-12 product for K-12 transcript fulfillment and credentials
- [District Transfer](https://www.parchment.com/platform/k-12/k-12-district-transfer): District Transfer platform for K-12 student records exchange
- [Cumulative Folders](https://www.parchment.com/platform/k-12/k-12-cumulative-folders): K-12 Cumulative Folders for digitized student file management
- [Document Management](https://www.parchment.com/platform/k-12/k-12-document-management): K-12 Document Management for records storage and disaster recovery
- [Records Digitization](https://www.parchment.com/platform/k-12/records-digitization): Records Digitization service for K-12 student document scanning
- [Diploma Services](https://www.parchment.com/platform/k-12/diploma-services): K-12 Diploma Services for digital and printed diploma issuance

## Student Resources

- [How It Works for Students](https://www.parchment.com/students/how-it-works): Guide for students ordering transcripts, diplomas, and digital badges
